Double Dagger Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Double Dagger is 0135. Hold Alt, type 0135 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Double Dagger also has the Unicode codepoint U+2021, so you can type it with Alt+8225 on Windows, search for U+2021 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ‡ in HTML, or \2021 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Double Dagger character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ‡ for Double Dagger, but the numeric form ‡ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type double dagger on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 3 5 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Double Dagger character (‡) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type double dagger on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Double Dagger. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Double Dagger" and click the character to insert it.

How to use double dagger in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\2021"; ()
  • Python: \u2021 or chr(0x2021)
  • JavaScript: \u2021 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2021)
  • JSON: "\u2021"
  • LaTeX: $\ddag$ (text mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Double Dagger?

The legacy Alt code for Double Dagger is 0135. Hold Alt, type 0 1 3 5 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ‡ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ‡, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8225 not work?

Alt+8225 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Double Dagger?

The Unicode codepoint for Double Dagger is U+2021. You can use this value in HTML as ‡, in CSS as \2021, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ‡ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2021, then click it.
